subject: Logic
title: False Positives Explained
description: A short lesson to help you apply False Positives Explained.

hook.text: Airport security flags your bag. You're clean. Happens constantly—and probability explains why.

buildup.text: A false positive occurs when a test says "yes" for something that's actually "no."

discovery.text: If threats are rare but the test flags 5% of safe bags, almost every flag is a false alarm.

twist.text: Making the test more sensitive catches more threats—but also increases false positives. A painful tradeoff.

climax.text: No test is perfect. Understanding false positive rates prevents overreacting to every alarm.
